# RimLumen

> Native HDR VFX, programmable ShaderPacks, and GPU compute particle framework for RimWorld 1.7 (Waylith / Vulkan engine).

RimLumen adds an `RGBA16F` HDR pipeline, configurable `0-7` mip bloom, depth-aware soft particles (`R32SFloat`), GPU compute and native CPU particles, purely visual ground-pool point lights, and declarative multi-pass ShaderPacks.

## Map composition order

Effective render queues form four unmerged groups: `q < 3152` → 3152, `[3152,3169)` → 3169, `[3169,3178)` → 3178, `[3178,int.MaxValue)` → map end. Each boundary precedes same-queue vanilla grabs. Group 0 runs native HDR, early glow, bloom and the ShaderPack DAG / composite once, before the 3152 Distortion grab, under the existing native / contributor / runOnEmptyFrames triggers even if early glow is empty. Pack `glow` contains only q < 3152 copies; `scene` and `depth` are same-frame 3152 snapshots. The PostEffectPass ABI, 208-byte UBO, mapLightField RGBA contract and `backbuffer` output name are unchanged.

Later groups redraw additive glow copies and use host prefilter / down / up and an RGB-additive bloom-only composite preserving destination alpha, without tone mapping or re-adding cores. They reuse the captured active pack's BloomParams and requested mip count; absent groups or zero mips add no boundary or passes. No native HDR, pack DAG / history, grading or fog reruns. Custom bloom shaders apply only to group 0. Late Cinematic copies produce no streaks or Adaptation; late Atmospheric bloom does not light mist or use fog-dependent scatter gain; pack composite colour mapping does not apply to late bloom.

Installed vanilla / DLC static inventory: ritual candles 3155 bloom at 3169 before weather fog 3169 and sun shadow 3170; orbital / power beams and endpoints 3177 bloom at 3178 after FogOfWar 3175 and before Gravship grab and Darkness 3180; grav-field 3181, engine 3185, thruster flame 3201 and Noctol eyes 4000 bloom at map end. No eligible inventory draws fall in 3169–3174 or 3178–3179. The map-end bloom is absent from the earlier 3201 Screen and 3251 VoidNode grabs; arbitrary overlay, grab and third-party ordering is not guaranteed. In-game behaviour has not been verified.

## Current ShaderPack input ABI

The UBO is now 208-byte std140 at set 0 binding 5; external packs must replace the old EnvParams block. Offsets: InvViewProjection 0 (mat4), ScreenAndMapSize 64 (vec4); floats GameSeconds 80, RealSeconds 84, SkyGlow 88, ZoomRootSize 92, HasHdrDraws 96, HasSceneDepth 100, HasMapLightField 104, IsPaused 108, DepthValid 112, GameDeltaSeconds 116, RealDeltaSeconds 120, ColorBlendSpace 124 (0 Legacy: hdr/bloom in stored units; 1 Linear: hdr/bloom in linear radiance, composite over the decoded scene and encode once); vec4 BloomParams 128, PackParams[4] at 144 (16-byte stride, row offsets 144/160/176/192, 64 bytes). Manifest target packParamN (N=0..15) maps to PackParams[N/4][N%4]; existing shaders must replace the old vector members with the array. Flags are independent 0/1 floats. Missing depth is reverse-Z far=0 with DepthValid=0; real boundary depth has DepthValid=1 (not a per-pixel geometry claim).

Particle DeltaTime and GameDeltaSeconds are actual TicksThisFrame/60, or zero when the host skips game update for LongEventHandler.ShouldWaitForEvent (Root_Play.Update AC:53551–53566); GameSeconds is TicksGame/60, stopping on pause. RealSeconds and RealDeltaSeconds are host elapsed/frame seconds. Vanilla speed requests are Normal 1, Fast 3, Superfast 6 (12 idle, 18 without maps), Ultrafast 15 (150 without maps, 20000 boosted), forced normal 1; completed ticks are budget-limited. Source: Verse.TickManager, Assembly-CSharp.decompiled.cs:52605–52646,52853–52888.

Cinematic StreakExtract and Adapt read hdr + glow; composite core reads hdr only. Adapt's exponential time constant is 0.2 game seconds: 1-exp(-GameDeltaSeconds/0.2). Default bloom threshold is 1.0 in settings and pack baseline; peak ≤ threshold extracts exactly 0. Knee=0 is a hard threshold without division by zero; positive knee uses excess*smoothstep(0,knee,excess) above threshold only.

mapLightField RGBA means Roofed / ArtificialGroundGlow / HasOutdoorTemperatureRoom / Fogged. R is RoofGrid.Roofed (AC:92166–92168), 255/0 as shipped. G is min(0.5,max(rgb)/255*3.6), rounded to UNorm8, excluding sky light (GlowGrid.GroundGlowAt artificial component, AC:69541–69542). B is 255 iff a Room exists AND Room.UsesOutdoorTemperature is true (AC:90349–90358), otherwise 0 including indoor-temperature Rooms and room-less walls/rock. This is a defined fact, not a placeholder or vanilla indoor/outdoor classification of room-less cells: TryGetDirectAirTemperatureForCell returns false/21f without a Room (AC:92707–92714), not that bool classification. No neighbour inference. A is FogGrid.IsFogged, 255/0 (AC:68695–68701). AC refers to Assembly-CSharp.decompiled.cs. Atmospheric reads roof R directly and combines it with B in its visual formula, enclosure=R*mix(1,0.55,B), leaving G strictly artificial light.

Turning vanilla glow enhancement off is pixel-identical only when no RimLumen effects are active and the active pack does not rewrite the scene.

## Documentation

- [English Developer API Manual](api.en.md): Complete reference for coordinates (`Vertical3D`, drawn as a true 60°-pitch orthographic view under the vanilla 2D camera / `GroundXZ`), `.lumen.json`, XML `LumenEffectDef`, the effect state machine (`states`, `stopState`, `Notify`), force fields, `RimLumenApi`, `LumenTextureRegistry`, `Chezhou.RimUnity` bridge, and the programmable `ShaderPacks` specification.
- [中文开发者 API 手册](api.md): Canonical Simplified Chinese developer manual (identical technical coverage; shipped in release packages at `docs/api.md`).
- [Project Overview & Build Commands](https://github.com/Neko-Yukari/RimLumen/blob/master/README.md): Bilingual modder/player feature overview and PowerShell build, test, and release packaging commands.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Neko-Yukari/RimLumen): Source repository for `RimLumen.Core`, `RimLumen.Adapter.RimUnity`, built-in `1.7/ShaderPacks/*`, and `1.7/Shaders/*`.

## Integration Surfaces

- **Effect coordinates**: The ground is the fixed world plane `Y = 0`. Every world position, including `LumenPlayRequest.OriginWorld`, uses Y as height above ground in cells, not a RimWorld draw-altitude layer. Node `LocalPosition` remains parent-relative. `Vertical3D` projects height `h` to `0.5 × h` cells up the screen in vanilla 2D (60° pitch) and uses full height in 3D / IsoRim. The XZ anchor is the play origin, fixed at birth for world-space particles. `KillBelowFloor` expires descending particles only below world `Y = 0`.
- **XML `LumenEffectDef`**: Define `RimLumen.Core.Assets.LumenEffectDef` in `Defs/**/*.xml` with no C# dependency. Supports nodes, emitters, curves, gradients, force fields, visual point lights (never written to `GlowGrid`; `overlightRadius` removed; overlapping pools sum linearly and the scene becomes `scene × (1 + C(ΣL))`, at most 2x; recommended `intensity` 0.5–1.2 for steady lamps and 1.0–2.0 for short bright flashes, do not copy vanilla `GlowGrid`'s 3.6 scale), `timelineEvents` and `states`.
- **`.lumen.json` Data Assets**: Place `*.lumen.json` under `<ModRoot>/1.7/Data/RimLumen/` or `<ModRoot>/Data/RimLumen/`. Supports strict typo checking, `timelineEvents`, named `states` (`duration` / `next` / `loop`, `initialState`, `stopState`), and `packageId:effectId` + first-writer-wins bare IDs. An explicit debug reload rebuilds the current JSON snapshot plus already-loaded XML Defs: fresh IDs replace same-named assets, including code registrations; stale scanner-owned keys are released, while unrelated code entries and later code overrides of stale keys survive. Playing instances stay unchanged, and XML files are never re-read. For imported RimUnity assets, calling `RimUnityAssetProvider.RegisterPackageRoot` again clears its catalogs and translated cache even when the path is unchanged.
- **Gameplay light (`CompRimLumenLogicalLight`)**: ThingDef comp `<li Class="RimLumen.Core.Lighting.CompProperties_RimLumenLogicalLight"><glowRadius>6</glowRadius></li>` (finite, (0, 40] cells). Raises only `GlowGrid.GroundGlowAt` like a white non-overlit `CompGlower` (vanilla 8-neighbour flood, wall occlusion, 0.5 cap, Max with vanilla and other logical lights, vacuum = 0); never enters `GlowGrid`, so `VisualGlowAt`, the vanilla overlay and `mapLightField` G stay untouched. Lit under `CompGlower` rules (spawned, `FlickUtility.WantsToBeOn`, every `IThingGlower`), same comp signals; recomputed in `GlowGridUpdate_First`. Pair with a `pointLight` effect for the visible pool; do not add `CompGlower`.
- **C# Runtime (`RimLumenApi`)**: Reference `1.7/Assemblies/RimLumen.Core.dll` and call `RimLumenApi.Play` / `PlayAtCell` / `RegisterEffect` / `TryGetEffect` on the main thread; control playback via `ILumenEffectHandle` (`Trigger`, `GoTo`, `SetParam`, `Stop`, `Dispose`) and receive `Notify` / `StateChanged` / `Finished`.
- **Programmable `ShaderPacks`**: Place `pack.json` and GLSL `#version 450` fragment shaders under `<ModRoot>/1.7/ShaderPacks/<Pack>/` or `Config/RimLumen/ShaderPacks/<Pack>/`. Declares custom intermediate targets (`R16G16B16A16SFloat`, `R8G8B8A8UNorm`, `R16SFloat`), persistent history (`prev:<name>`), `InvViewProjection` + Reverse-Z `depth` + 4-channel `mapLightField` + bloom-only vanilla additive `glow`, custom bloom shaders, live `options[]` sliders, and isolated hot reload.
